profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, traded under the ticker AUR. According to its website, it works on self-driving freight powered by the Aurora Driver, which the company describes as built with cutting-edge hardware and powerful software backed by verifiable AI and as integrating the benefits of autonomy into a fleet. The site frames the company's stated aim as delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site presents the Aurora Driver as a system for autonomous trucking and includes quoted comments from partners and customers. One quote describes a pilot program hauling freight autonomously between Fort Worth and El Paso and a hybrid model combining professional drivers with the Aurora Driver. Another says freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010-2050 and that the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous. A further quote says the self-driving system has performed over millions of autonomous miles.

The record also lists a Pennsylvania law exposure entry with a count of 176. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for the company.
